title: Tax Regime Compare
description: Stops salaried people in India picking the tax regime that costs them more by working out tax year 2026-27 tax under the old and new regimes from salary, HRA (with the 8 cities at 50% under rule 279), 80C, 80D, NPS and home-loan interest, showing the break-even deductions, and flagging a choice that costs more, deductions that don't count under the new regime and claims over their limit, each with a one-tap fix.
